## History

Irving rekindled his past romance with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) years after their initial quarrel. He later married Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) in a joyful wedding ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), after which the newlyweds received a warm farewell send-off.

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--lavendar-lewis.md)

Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) is the stepmother of Irving's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), following her marriage to Irving's father, [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md). After recounting her past romance and quarrel with [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) was introduced to [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a month later, and the two immediately established a affectionate friendship during that initial visit. She later married [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) following their courtship.

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017), +8 more_

- Romantically involved with — courting and taking walks in the woods together  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P4](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0004), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)</sub>
